Zuzul Ralph J. Maffei Associate Professor of Business Administration Ralph J. Maffei Associate Professor of Business Administration Read more Tiona Zuzul is the Ralph J. Maffei Associate Professor of Business Administration in the Strategy Unit. She teaches the MBA elective Making Difficult Decisions, a PhD seminar in Strategy Research Development, and contributes to various executive education programs. Professor Zuzul studies how leaders’ cognition and communication shape the decisions and behaviors that drive organizational outcomes. She was named a Poets & Quants 40 Best Under 40 Business School Professors
